_note: Only official streams go here. Each channel can have several URLs; the app tries them in order until one plays.

tv.name: NHK World-Japan
tv.desc: NHK's free international channel (English news, Japan culture). Official stream.

tv.name: 日テレNEWS 24 (Nippon TV)
tv.desc: Nippon TV's official 24-hour news live on YouTube. Plays in the app.

tv.name: TBS NEWS DIG
tv.desc: TBS's official news channel on YouTube. Plays when they are live.

tv.name: ANN News (TV Asahi)
tv.desc: TV Asahi's official news channel. Live news several times a day. Opens YouTube.

tv.name: テレ東BIZ (TV Tokyo Business)
tv.desc: TV Tokyo's official business & market news. Market live every Friday 3 PM Japan time (Thursday 10 PM in California). Opens YouTube.

tv.name: ABEMA Prime (official YouTube)
tv.desc: ABEMA's news/debate show. ABEMA's own app is Japan-only, but this show posts on YouTube. Opens YouTube.

tv.name: Shop Channel
tv.desc: Japanese home-shopping channel. Good for listening practice. Official stream, not 24/7.

tv.name: Weathernews LiVE
tv.desc: Japanese weather news, live on its official YouTube channel. Opens YouTube.
